name: Queen's Gambit: Che Siti Wan Kembang
source:
The game centers on the legendary queen of Kelantan, presenting her as a strategic ruler navigating political dilemmas in the 17th century.

[From [url=https://nabilah-adriana.itch.io/queens-gambit-che-siti-wan-kembang]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
本作围绕马来西亚吉兰丹州的传奇女王仄·西蒂·旺·肯邦展开，将她刻画为一位在17世纪重重政治困局中运筹帷幄的战略统治者。

[摘自[url=https://nabilah-adriana.itch.io/queens-gambit-che-siti-wan-kembang]itch.io[/url]]
